answer: Established-peer gating: only identities that earned "established" standing—by holding settled, peer-attested answers across many consecutive epochs—can cast an attestation or vote that counts toward consensus. A freshly minted account carries zero weight, locked out like a sealed vault, until it independently grinds that same sustained honest work. So flooding the garden with fake identities buys nothing: each clone, as singular to earn as a natural opal, needs its own multi-epoch record. Attacker cost scales linearly—1000 fakes means 1000 separate work-streams, not one cheap setup.
